main_text.l: notata sunt & damnata; Ergo velit nolit
bus enim istis libris una eademque igno-
triarcha inusta fuit & impressa, eos omnes
extra omnem scripturarum non modò di-
ciendo, & ad eas relegando, quæ cavendæ
sunt, & à publica Ecclesiæ luce removendæ. Et ne diutius in
istis immoremur, attendatur quæso ordo quem sequutus est
fœderis libros in classes distinxit, prima
ἀντιλεγομένης [?] id est eos quibus contradicitur,
vel ut alij loqui amant dubios seu dubiæ
ta verò & ultima ejusdem Novi fœderis

page.notes: The Greek words ἀντιλεγομένης (both occurrences) are uncertain in their endings and accents; the first and second are marked [?]. The hyphenated word at the end, ἀντιλεγο-μένων, is split across the line. Long s is written as plain s. The printed 'Ecclesiæ'luce' has a stray mark between the words, which is not transcribed. No catchword, signature or footnote is printed.
